endangerment.comment: Portuguese Sign Language (7358-psr) = Threatened (20 percent certain, based on the evidence available) [Lewis 2009](cldf:lewis:ed:09)

classification.sub: Although there is a historical connection to 19th century Swedish Sign language (**hh:h:Woll:Global-Sign**):29, visible at least in the fingerspelling alphabet, lexical comparison shows that Portuguese Sign Language does not belong to the Swedish Sign language family (**hh:vw:Brudzewski:Portugal-Sign**).
